items.sentence: Today, heavy fog made the sailors cancel the morning trip.
Now, the carpenter will replace the cracked wooden step today.
A property dispute between neighbors belongs to private law.
The shop offered a refund for the broken umbrella.
One robin sang on the highest branch this morning.
The garden will recover rapidly after the gentle rain.
Today, the long winter hardship ended with warm spring days.
Several children assemble a wooden model of a windmill.
Today, the parade will proceed along the main street now.
Today, bright lightning will precede the sound of the thunder.
